title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna
narration: OpenAI just released GPT-6 Sol and Luna, and the biggest change may be cost. Sol now costs two dollars per million input tokens and ten dollars for output, while Luna drops to ten cents input and fifty cents output. OpenAI says Sol reaches 68.8 percent on DeepSWE, within 1.1 points of Claude Fable 5's best result, at roughly 80 percent lower cost per task. GPT-6 also improves prompt caching, with cached input reads discounted by 90 percent. Astra is still OpenAI's top model, but Sol and Luna make advanced coding and agent workloads much cheaper.

scenes.title: 90% cached-input discount
scenes.body: Better prompt caching can cut the cost of long-running agents and repeated context.

scenes.title: Astra is still the top model
scenes.body: Sol and Luna are the faster, cheaper tiers—not the maximum-capability option.
